targets.authors: Kay, A. C., Gaucher, D., Napier, J. L., Callan, M. J., & Laurin, K.
targets.title: God and the government: Testing a compensatory control mechanism for the support of external systems.
targets.evidence_quote:
We thus aimed to conduct a direct replication of crucial eﬀect of the original Study 1 by
Kay et al. (2008), including exactly the same manipulations and measures (excluding the
extra control condition).
targets.outcome_quote:
Our results indicate moderate to strong evidence for the absence of this
eﬀect: belief in (a controlling) God is not modulated by a threat compared to an aﬃrma-
tion of personal control. Using large samples (N  400) we did not replicate the original
experiment by Kay et al. (2008) in the Netherlands, nor in the US.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall replication failure in both countries. Manipulation limitations do not supersede that verdict. Correlational extensions and positive controls do not change the central replication outcome.

reasoning: Completed direct replication in new Dutch and US samples. Meta-analysis of preceding studies is background; these are not additional replication targets. No DOI is printed for the original in the references.
